text: The authors note their work uses reading comprehension over short stories of about 8000 tokens and pose the open question of how well the approach generalises to domains where a much larger set of evidence is required, such as quoting published literature for a science question. They add that stronger models may hold parametric knowledge that is not easily citeable or verifiable by any specific tool.
title: Does debate generalise to larger evidence bases or uncitable parametric knowledge?
